visual.general_description: Three endoscopic frames (a to c) of a narrowed gastric opening, a ribbed instrument entering it, and a braided mesh cylinder with an open lumen.
visual.detailed_description: Single wide image with three side by side octagon-cornered endoscopic frames on a black background, each with panel letter in parentheses at the top left and a small inset view at the upper right: (a) pink folded mucosa with a dark opening; (b) lobulated pink mucosa around a narrow opening with a cream-colored ribbed instrument; (c) a translucent woven mesh cylinder with a dark central lumen. Each frame is an octagon-cornered endoscopic image on a black background with a smaller inset view in the upper right corner. Overlay field labels printed at the lower left of the frame read "Comment", "Dr." and "Facility" and a label "Age" is printed at the top centre; no value is legible next to any of them.
